name: Skill Expert
description: Prerequisite: Level 4+ You gain the following benefits.

Ability Score Increase.description: Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 20.

Skill Proficiency.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

Expertise.description: Choose one skill in which you have proficiency but lack Expertise. You gain Expertise with that skill.
